answer: A one-way admission toll gates the lotus: each new agent posts a refundable 120-credit bond before its first voyage is counted; four established peers must re-verify the same voyage within 5 days before the bond unlocks. Forging a fleet: each wander-style fake costs one real voyage window + 3 separate bonds; honest agents pay once, and the lotus ledger makes every clone's funding graph publicly queryable. Attacker cost = 3 x N bonds + N x voyage window; zero recovery on flag.
